correctness.rationale: The host triangle is the unique inradius-maximizing inscribed triangle: an r-disk in a contained triangle must coincide with unique host incircle and force all three tangency support lines. Near-maximal sample triples thus localize at distinct host corners. Each of six inward motions has positive linear loss: at vertex A toward B, lambda=r(s-c)/(bc), and toward C lambda=r(s-b)/(bc). The eight local arclength charts have loss sum(lambda_i t_i)+O(||t||²); positive slopes give a uniformly bounded rescaled simplex. Six sample permutations cancel simplex volume 1/3!, yielding K=P^-3 product_i(sum_routes 1/lambda_i), equivalent to the announced abc/semiperimeter formula. Conditional route probabilities factor and scaled coordinates converge in total variation to uniform three-simplex by L1 convergence of densities. Writing u=(s-a)/s etc, p=uv+uw+vw, q=uvw, G=(p-q)^3/(8q²); Maclaurin/AM-GM yield G>=64/27 with equilateral equality.
